sections.title: A second way to talk about the future
sections.content: Hungarian has a real future tense too, built from fog plus a plain infinitive (the -ni form of the main verb). Conjugate fog for the person, then add the infinitive of the main verb straight after it, completely unchanged — the infinitive never conjugates, no matter who's doing the action. Holnap fogok dolgozni ("Tomorrow I will work").

fog is the one piece that conjugates here — think of it like English "will". Everything after it stays a bare infinitive: fogok menni, fogsz menni, fog menni, never fogok megyek or anything with a personal ending on the main verb.
